popCulture.title: Epigoni (epic)
popCulture.description: The lost cyclic sequel to the Thebaid — the sons of the Seven take Thebes at last, and only a line or two of the old poem survives.

popCulture.title: Epigoni
popCulture.description: Alcmaeon, Diomedes, and the second Argive generation — the revenge war that closes the Theban cycle before Troy.

popCulture.title: Theban Cycle
popCulture.description: The Epigoni sit in the cycle between the Seven's failure and the Trojan generation — Cadmus' city falling twice in epic memory.

popCulture.title: Thebaid
popCulture.creator: Statius
popCulture.description: Statius' Latin epic ends with the Seven, but its Theban war remains the chief surviving frame for every later Epigoni retelling.
